About

Hi, I’m Shivansh Anand 👋

I’m a Software Engineer passionate about building robust, high-performance backend systems, optimizing cloud infrastructure, and exploring the frontiers of Agentic AI and modern developer tooling.

Currently, I work at Target, where I design scalable microservices and graph-based solutions to solve complex domain problems—like uncovering multi-million dollar fraud rings and streaming gigabyte-scale datasets cleanly and efficiently.

What I Work With 🛠️

  • Backend & Cloud: Java, Spring Boot, WebFlux, Microservices, Kafka, Docker, AWS
  • Databases & Caching: Neo4j, Cassandra, Redis, PostgreSQL, MySQL
  • Observability & Testing: Grafana, Kibana, Splunk, JUnit, Mockito, TDD
  • AI & Modern Tooling: Agentic AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), GitHub Copilot, Spec-Driven Development

What You’ll Find On This Blog 💡

This site serves as my digital notebook and engineering journal. Here, I write about:

  1. System Design & Performance: Lessons learned from real-world optimizations, low-latency architectures, and infrastructure cost reductions.
  2. Modern AI & Developer Workflows: Deep dives into practical AI integrations, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and evolving development paradigms.
  3. Project Technical Deep Dives: Detailed breakdowns of my side projects (like real-time WebSocket distributed engines and game logic).
